title: Angular Front End Developer
description:
## About the Company

Emerald Business Ventures Pvt. Ltd. develops technology-driven fintech and enterprise software solutions, including merchant onboarding, digital payments, prepaid cards, HRMS, expense management, and other business platforms. We are looking for a skilled Angular Frontend Developer to build secure, scalable, responsive, and user-friendly web applications.

## Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Angular Frontend Developer with strong knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and REST API integration. The candidate will be responsible for developing reusable UI components, implementing business workflows, integrating backend APIs, and delivering high-quality frontend solutions in collaboration with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and QA teams.

## Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain responsive web applications using Angular.

- Build reusable components, services, directives, pipes, and modules following Angular best practices.

- Develop enterprise dashboards, data tables, forms, filters, reports, and role-based user interfaces.

- Integrate RESTful APIs using Angular HttpClient and handle API responses, errors, loading states, and validation messages.

- Implement reactive forms, form validations, dynamic forms, and complex business workflows.

- Develop secure authentication and authorization flows, including JWT-based authentication, route guards, and role-based access control.

- Implement Angular routing, lazy loading, and optimized application navigation.

- Use RxJS and Observables for asynchronous operations and API data handling.

- Develop dashboards with charts, KPIs, transaction summaries, and data visualization.

- Work with Bootstrap 5, SCSS/CSS, and component libraries such as CoreUI or Angular Material.

- Ensure cross-browser compatibility, responsive layouts, accessibility, and consistent UI/UX.

- Optimize frontend performance through efficient rendering, pagination, caching strategies, and code splitting.

- Collaborate with backend developers working on Java/Spring Boot or other REST API services.

- Debug issues, fix defects, participate in code reviews, and maintain clean, reusable, and well-documented code.

- Write unit tests where applicable and support QA, UAT, deployment, and production issue resolution.

- Follow Git-based version control and established software development practices.

## Required Technical Skills

- Strong hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript.

- Good understanding of JavaScript ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.

- Experience with Angular components, services, directives, pipes, routing, and dependency injection.

- Strong understanding of Reactive Forms, form validation, and dynamic form handling.

- Experience integrating REST APIs using HttpClient.

- Working knowledge of RxJS, Observables, Promises, and asynchronous programming.

- Experience with Bootstrap 5 and SCSS/CSS.

- Knowledge of JWT authentication, route guards, interceptors, and role-based access control.

- Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.

- Understanding of browser debugging, frontend performance optimization, and error handling.

## Good to Have

- Experience with Angular standalone components and modern Angular control flow.

- Experience with Angular Material, CoreUI, or similar UI frameworks.

- Experience building fintech, banking, payment, merchant onboarding, ERP, or HRMS applications.

- Knowledge of dashboard libraries such as Chart.js, ECharts, or ApexCharts.

- Familiarity with pagination, sorting, server-side filtering, file uploads, and Excel/CSV exports.

- Basic understanding of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and API security.

- Experience with unit testing using Jasmine/Karma or Jest.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and application deployment processes.

## Educational Qualification

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- B.Tech, BCA, MCA, or equivalent qualifications are preferred.

- Relevant practical experience and demonstrable project work are important.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior React Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior React Developer

Position: Senior React Developer

Experience: 5–6 years of employment

Type: Full-Time

Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills are mandatory. Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Senior React Developer with 5–6 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, responsive, and high performance web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, modern frontend technologies, and REST API integration. The candidate should possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, understand business requirements, and contribute to technical discussions. Key Responsibilities  Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React.js.  Build reusable, efficient, and high-quality UI components.  Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces compatible with multiple browsers and devices.  Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code following frontend development best practices.  Integrate RESTful APIs and work with backend developers to ensure seamless data flow.  Manage application state using Redux, Context API, or other state management solutions.  Optimize application performance, rendering, and loading speed.  Implement routing, form validation, authentication, and authorization.  Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality, security, and maintainability.  Identify and troubleshoot technical issues and production defects.  Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders.  Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, estimations, and technical discussions.  Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical improvements where required. Required Technical Skills  Strong hands-on experience with React.js.  Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.  Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.  Experience with React Hooks, functional components, and component lifecycle concepts.  Experience with state management tools such as Redux, Redux Toolkit, or Context API.  Experience integrating REST APIs and handling asynchronous operations.  Knowledge of React Router and modern frontend architecture.  Experience with UI frameworks such as Material UI, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, or similar.  Understanding of browser compatibility, web accessibility, and frontend security.  Experience with Git and version control systems.  Familiarity with unit testing tools such as Jest and React Testing Library.  Understanding of build tools, package managers, and frontend optimization techniques.  Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Preferred Qualifications  Experience developing enterprise-scale web applications.  Knowledge of Next.js and server-side rendering.  Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment.  Experience with performance profiling and optimization.  Exposure to micro-frontends and reusable component libraries.  Knowledge of accessibility standards such as WCAG.  Experience with automated testing and code-quality tools. Soft Skills  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.  Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.  Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.  Ability to understand requirements and provide technical inputs.  Proactive attitude with strong ownership and accountability.  Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment. Experience Requirements  Minimum 5 years and maximum 6 years of relevant React development experience.  Candidates should have strong hands-on expertise in React.js and modern frontend technologies.  Strong communication skills are mandatory.  Candidates with less than 5 years or more than 6 years of relevant experience should not apply if they fall outside the specified experience range. Important Note Candidates must have 5–6 years of relevant React development experience and strong communication skills. Both requirements are mandatory for this position.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Frontend Developer( 3-5 years)
description:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced **Senior Frontend Developer with 3–5 years** of experience in developing responsive, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks such as React.js or Angular. The candidate will work closely with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members to build scalable and high-quality web applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, maintain, and optimize responsive web applications using modern frontend technologies.
* Build reusable UI components and frontend libraries for future use.
* Develop interactive user interfaces using React.js, Angular, or similar frameworks.
* Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well-documented code.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement user-friendly and visually appealing designs.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services into frontend applications.
* Optimize applications for speed, performance, and scalability.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs and technical issues.
* Follow frontend development best practices and coding standards.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Work closely with backend developers to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend systems.
* Stay updated with the latest frontend technologies, tools, and industry trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3–5 years of professional experience in frontend development.
* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and ES6+.
* Hands-on experience with React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Good understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with REST APIs and JSON.
* Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
* Understanding of state management libraries such as Redux, Context API, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of frontend build tools such as Vite, Webpack, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with frontend testing tools and debugging techniques.
* Good understanding of website performance optimization and web security fundamentals.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with TypeScript.
* Familiarity with Next.js or other server-side rendering frameworks.
* Knowledge of UI libraries such as Material UI, Tailwind CSS, or Bootstrap.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Understanding of accessibility standards and SEO-friendly frontend development.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Software Engineering Manager - Java, React, DevOps
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

We are seeking a talented and motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team. A successful candidate will play a key role in DevOps, designing, developing, and implementing new features for the BnE platform.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Participate in the entire application lifecycle, focusing on coding and debugging
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code
* Collaborate with the team to design and launch new features
* Maintain and improve the performance of existing software
* Clearly and regularly communicate with management and technical support colleagues
* Participate in our agile development process, Scrum
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate degree or equivalent experience
* Experience with backend API development
* MySql, MongoDB and experience designing and maintaining databases
* Proven experience as a Lead/Sr Software Engineer or similar role
* Understanding of fundamental design principles behind scalable applications and DevOps
* Solid proficiency with Spring, Spring boot, Java, JavaScript and familiarity with React/Angular
* Demonstrated excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Demonstrated solid team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proven quick learner who is excited about learning new programming languages and technologies

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Front End Developer ( UI/UX)
description:
**Company:** CSG Technosol Private Limited  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates Can Apply  
**Hiring Mode:** Walk\-In / CV Submission  
**Starting Salary for Freshers:** ₹15,000 per month  
**Commitment for Freshers:** 2 Years Written Commitment

**About the Role**

CSG Technosol is looking for a **creative and passionate Frontend (UI/UX) Developer** who has a strong sense of design, aesthetics and user experience. We are looking for someone who doesn’t just write frontend code, but can **think creatively about how a product should look, feel and interact with users**. The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about modern web design, responsive interfaces, animations, usability and emerging UI/UX trends.

**Freshers with strong creativity, good fundamentals and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop **modern, attractive, responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces**.
* Convert concepts, wireframes, Figma designs and requirements into functional frontend interfaces.
* Create engaging layouts with a strong focus on **UI/UX, typography, spacing, colors, usability and visual consistency**.
* Build responsive interfaces that work smoothly across desktop, tablet and mobile devices.
* Develop reusable frontend components and maintain clean, structured code.
* Work with modern frontend frameworks and libraries.
* Create smooth **animations, transitions, micro\-interactions and interactive user experiences** where appropriate.
* Collaborate with backend developers, designers and project teams to build complete applications.
* Optimize frontend applications for **performance, accessibility, responsiveness and cross\-browser compatibility**.
* Continuously explore new UI/UX trends, tools, frameworks and technologies.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

Candidates should have knowledge of, or a strong interest in, technologies such as:

* **HTML5 \& CSS3**
* **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* **React.js and/or Next.js**
* **Tailwind CSS / Bootstrap / Material UI or similar modern UI frameworks**
* Responsive \& Mobile\-First Design
* Modern CSS, Flexbox \& CSS Grid
* UI Components \& Design Systems
* REST API integration
* Git / Version Control
* Basic understanding of frontend performance and SEO

Knowledge of the following will be an added advantage:

* **Figma / Adobe XD or similar UI/UX design tools**
* Framer Motion / GSAP or other animation libraries
* Shadcn/UI or other modern component libraries
* React Native or other mobile UI technologies
* Accessibility (WCAG) principles
* AI\-assisted design and development tools

**Most Important: Creativity**

For this role, **creativity matters as much as technical knowledge**.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can:

* Think beyond standard templates.
* Create visually impressive yet practical interfaces.
* Understand what makes a UI feel modern and premium.
* Pay attention to small design details.
* Suggest improvements instead of simply following instructions.
* Understand the user’s perspective while designing an interface.
* Keep themselves updated with modern UI/UX trends.

**Eligibility**

* Freshers as well as experienced candidates can apply.
* Candidates from **B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. IT/CS, Diploma, or other relevant technical backgrounds** are preferred.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they have strong frontend/UI/UX skills and a good portfolio.
* Freshers should have good fundamentals and be willing to learn modern frontend technologies.
* A portfolio, GitHub profile, live project, Figma design, or sample UI work will be an advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
